commit.message:
Implement robust CI/CD pipelines and security measures across all environments

This commit introduces comprehensive CI/CD workflows, including security scanning, testing, and deployment to development, staging, and production environments. It also enhances infrastructure management with Terraform, integrates Kyverno for policy enforcement, and sets up Grafana for monitoring and Argo Rollouts for progressive delivery.
